children.value: The mass balance system provides detailed chemical-level analysis for each treatment unit in the water treatment process. It tracks the transformation of water quality parameters from influent to effluent streams, enabling comprehensive analysis of treatment efficiency and chemical changes.
Each treatment unit maintains its own mass balance based on PHREEQC solution objects, allowing for precise tracking of:
- Individual ion concentrations (Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺, Na⁺, Cl⁻, etc.)
The mass balance tracks changes in the main product stream:
- Relative change as percentage of influent value
For treatment units with waste streams, the mass balance provides:
